snippet.title: Solo Dev Project | 3D Sci-Fi Exploration Action Adventure | The Solyani's Code - Trailer
snippet.description:
The Solyani's Code is a 3D Sci-Fi Action-Adventure developed by a one-man team.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/341100/The_Solyanis_Code/

Experience a journey that blends fast-paced combat with deep exploration. Help Elara tackle headaches that are way above her pay grade. Together with Luma, a mysterious floating companion, scout the moon Selene, face down ancient threats, crack environmental puzzles, and brave temples that no technical manual could have ever prepped her for.

Demo coming soon! Add to your wishlist to be the first to play.

#SoloDev #openworld #3dgame #actionadventure #SciFi #IndieGame #TheSolyanisCode
